BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Wedding Drinkware Without Glass: A Reception Buying Brief

Start with venue rules and the service plan, then compare vessels, artwork versions and packing.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Map the service moments

A reception toast, seated drink service and a welcome kit may need different vessels. HJB-036 is a recorded 7 oz coupe reference; compare its presentation role with a flute or a general event cup.

Control names and artwork versions

Identify each design, colour reference and quantity. Ask how variable names, dates or multiple artwork versions affect the proof and quotation; do not assume a single setup covers them all.

Review packing and approvals

Agree artwork layout, physical sample needs, packing and the required arrival date. A digital event concept is not a completed customer case or a guarantee of the finished appearance.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.
